tool.name: OGS: generateStructuredMesh
tool.command: generateStructuredMesh --element-type '$element_type' #if str($lx) --lx '$lx' #end if #if str($ly) --ly '$ly' #end if #if str($lz) --lz '$lz' #end if #if str($nx) --nx '$nx' #end if #if str($ny) --ny '$ny' #end if #if str($nz) --nz '$nz' #end if #if str($dx0) --dx0 '$dx0' #end if #if str($dy0) --dy0 '$dy0' #end if #if str($dz0) --dz0 '$dz0' #end if #if str($dx_max) --dx-max '$dx_max' #end if #if str($dy_max) --dy-max '$dy_max' #end if #if str($dz_max) --dz-max '$dz_max' #end if #if str($mx) --mx '$mx' #end if #if str($my) --my '$my' #end if #if str($mz) --mz '$mz' #end if #if str($ox) --ox '$ox' #end if #if str($oy) --oy '$oy' #end if #if str($oz) --oz '$oz' #end if --mesh-output-file output_1.vtu

param.label: lx
param.help: length of a domain in x direction

param.label: ly
param.help: length of a domain in y direction

param.label: lz
param.help: length of a domain in z direction

param.label: nx
param.help: the number of subdivision in x direction

param.label: ny
param.help: the number of subdivision in y direction

param.label: nz
param.help: the number of subdivision in z direction

param.label: dx0
param.help: initial cell length in x direction

param.label: dy0
param.help: initial cell length in y direction

param.label: dz0
param.help: initial cell length in z direction

param.label: dx max
param.help: maximum cell length in x direction

param.label: dy max
param.help: maximum cell length in y direction

param.label: dz max
param.help: maximum cell length in z direction

param.label: ox
param.help: mesh origin (lower left corner) in x direction

param.label: oy
param.help: mesh origin (lower left corner) in y direction

param.label: oz
param.help: mesh origin (lower left corner) in z direction

tool.help: Structured mesh generator. The documentation is available at https://docs.opengeosys.org/docs/tools/meshing/structured-mesh-generation.
